title: DNA extraction from Atlantic salmon embryos for microsatellite validation of triploidy
author: Callum Howard

steps.title: Remove ethanol from stored eggs
steps.instruction: If eggs are stored in ethanol, grasp each egg with forceps, place on clean tissue, and blot to remove excess ethanol.

steps.title: Treat embryos in Tris‑HCl
steps.instruction: Place embryos in a beaker containing Tris‑HCl buffer (5 mM, pH 8) and incubate for 15 minutes; then remove the embryos and blot excess liquid with clean tissue.

steps.title: Allocate embryos to tubes or plate
steps.instruction: For low‑throughput, transfer each embryo to an individual 1.5 mL screw‑cap tube; for high‑throughput, place one embryo per well in a 2 mL deep 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Pierce chorion and sterilise forceps
steps.instruction: Pierce each embryo’s chorion by applying pressure with the tip of the forceps; between embryos, wipe the forceps clean and sterilise with 100 % ethanol followed by ddH₂O.

steps.title: Add alkaline lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL alkaline lysis buffer to each tube or well and seal.

steps.title: Lyse embryos at 90 °C
steps.instruction: Invert the sealed tubes/wells 5 times, then incubate in a heat block or oven at 90 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cool on ice
steps.instruction: Remove the tubes/wells and place on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Neutralise lysate
steps.instruction: Unseal and add 400 µL neutralisation buffer (equal volume), reseal, and invert rapidly 10 times.

steps.title: Brief centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin briefly in a centrifuge to collect liquid, then spin at 14 000 rpm (≈20 000 g) for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Collect DNA‑containing middle layer
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, carefully collect the middle aqueous layer; the bottom layer contains egg debris and the top layer contains lipids.

steps.title: Store extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Use the DNA immediately, store at 4 °C for up to a week, or at –18 °C for longer‑term storage.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube or plate, combine 0.5 µL extracted DNA, 3 µL MyTaq HS mix (Bioline, USA), 0.12 µL each primer (0.6 pM final), and 2.26 µL ultrapure water to a total volume of 10 µL.

steps.title: Run PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Thermocycle the PCR mix for 38 cycles of 95 °C for 15 s, 60 °C for 15 s, and 72 °C for 40 s (plus any required initial denaturation).

steps.title: Prepare agarose gel
steps.instruction: Make a 1.25 % agarose gel in 0.5× TAE buffer, add 5 µL 1.5× loading dye, and allow to solidify.

steps.title: Load and run gel
steps.instruction: Load 2.5 µL of PCR product into each well, run the gel, stain with ethidium bromide, and visualise bands under UV illumination.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR master mix
steps.instruction: In a qPCR plate, combine 1 µL extracted DNA, 5 µL Sensifast SYBR No‑ROX kit (Bioline, USA), 0.2 µL each primer (1 pM final), and 3.6 µL ultrapure water to a total of 10 µL.

steps.title: Run qPCR amplification
steps.instruction: Thermocycle with an initial step of 95 °C for 3 minutes, then 40 cycles of 95 °C for 15 s, 60 °C for 15 s, and 72 °C for 30 s.

steps.title: Prepare capillary electrophoresis sample
steps.instruction: Based on band intensity, take 0.5–1 µL PCR product, mix with 30 µL sample loading solution (SLS) and 0.35 µL WellRED size standard (Eurofins, Germany), and add the mixture to a well of the capillary electrophoresis plate.

steps.title: Add mineral oil overlay
steps.instruction: Top each well with one drop of mineral oil.

steps.title: Run capillary electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the Beckman Coulter CEQ 8000 capillary electrophoresis system according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
